description: This file defines the implementation of the VertexBuffer class and related classes such as VertexBufferInterface, StreamingVertexBufferInterface, and StaticVertexBufferInterface, which handle graphics API agnostic vertex buffer operations for Direct3D in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class managing reference counting and serial number for vertex buffers.

classes.name: VertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing vertex buffer operations, including size, serial, and discard.

classes.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for streaming dynamic vertex buffers with space reservation and attribute storage.

classes.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static vertex buffers with attribute signature matching and static attribute storage.

classes.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface::AttributeSignature
classes.description: Helper class to match and set attribute signatures for static vertex buffers.

methods.name: VertexBuffer::updateSerial
methods.description: Updates the serial number for the vertex buffer.

methods.name: VertexBuffer::getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: VertexBuffer::release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: VertexBufferInterface::getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the associated vertex buffer.

methods.name: VertexBufferInterface::getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: VertexBufferInterface::setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the buffer size, initializing if currently zero.

methods.name: VertexBufferInterface::getSpaceRequired
methods.description: Calculates and returns the space required for vertex attributes, aligned to 16 bytes.

methods.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer with a specified size.

methods.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface::reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer by releasing and recreating it.

methods.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface::reserveSpace
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface::storeDynamicAttribute
methods.description: Stores dynamic vertex attribute data into the buffer.

methods.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface::reserveVertexSpace
methods.description: Reserves space for static vertex attributes, aligned to 16 bytes.

methods.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface::AttributeSignature::matchesAttribute
methods.description: Checks if the attribute matches the signature.

methods.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface::AttributeSignature::set
methods.description: Sets the signature based on a given attribute and binding.

methods.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface::storeStaticAttribute
methods.description: Stores static attribute data into the buffer.
